primitives.note: Toggle between Human Form (ranged Q/W/E: Neurotoxin, Volatile Spiderling, Cocoon) and Spider Form (melee Q/W/E: Venomous Bite, Skittering Frenzy, Rappel), each with separate cooldowns; only Spider Form grants the on-hit passive and active Spiderling swarm.
In Spider Form, Elise's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage (12-42 +15% AP) and heal her (6-12 +8% AP) on-hit, as proc damage separate from the attack itself.

Dormant Spiderlings (stored via P, up to a rank-based cap) are summoned and healed to full when entering Spider Form via R, and fight independently; Volatile Spiderling (W) is also a separate damage-dealing entity that chases and explodes.

Neurotoxin (Human Q) scales off target's current HP%, Venomous Bite (Spider Q) scales off target's missing HP%; both are capped against monsters (irrelevant vs a champion-flagged dummy but present in the data).
Neurotoxin/Venomous Bite deal damage on a 0.25s cast/dash on a 6s cooldown; Volatile Spiderling deals AoE damage on contact/expiry on a 12s cooldown.
Skittering Frenzy (Spider Form W) grants Elise and her Spiderlings bonus attack speed for 3s; also has a permanent passive attack-speed bonus to Spiderlings.
Skittering Frenzy resets Elise's basic attack timer on cast.
Mana costs (Q 80-100, W 60-100, E 50) constrain how many casts fit in a 15s window at low levels/mana pools.
Rappel (Spider Form E) is a lift-up/vanish then a recast that descends on a target and grants a 40-100% increase to Spider Queen bonuses for 5s afterward.
Elise gains one dormant Spiderling per landed ability cast in Human Form, capped at a rank-based value (2-5), which determines how many Spiderlings are available when she next enters Spider Form.
Rappel's lift-up grants untargetability/unable-to-act, relevant only to the survival fight (dodging the enemy rotation), never read by the damage-fight dummy.

needsBespoke.why: Elise's damage output is dominated by an independent pet swarm (Spiderlings) whose count, attack speed, AP ratio, and uptime depend on a chain of mechanics not fully specified here: how many Spiderlings are stored at fight start, how many spawn/attack when Spider Form is entered, their own attack cadence and how Skittering Frenzy's attack-speed buff (passive + active) applies to them, and how the unresolved bin calculation {9e9e2e5c} for the Rappel-recast damage bonus resolves. A generic 'pet-or-summon' primitive cannot capture the stacking/summon-on-form-switch lifecycle, the interaction between Human-Form storage and Spider-Form summon-and-heal, and the AS-cap-breaking Skittering Frenzy stacking on top of the swarm without bespoke logic.

proposal: Start in Human Form and cast Neurotoxin (Q) on the dummy immediately (its damage is a fraction of the target's current HP, so it is strongest when the target is at full health).
Cast Volatile Spiderling (W) at the dummy right after, for its AoE burst and to store a Spiderling.
Toggle to Spider Form (R) as soon as the opener is done, which summons all stored Spiderlings at full health to fight alongside Elise.
Auto-attack continuously while in Spider Form to trigger Spider Queen's on-hit bonus magic damage and self-heal on every attack.
Recast the Spider-Form Q (Venomous Bite) on cooldown, biting the target for missing-health-based damage and applying on-hit effects; this also pulls Spiderlings in to attack.
Cast Skittering Frenzy (Spider-Form W) on cooldown for the attack-speed buff to Elise and her Spiderlings and to reset Elise's attack timer for extra swings.

Remain in Spider Form for the rest of the 15s window rather than swapping back to Human Form, since re-entering Human Form loses the active Spiderling swarm and Spider Queen on-hit bonus, and each form swap costs its own 3s cooldown.
Skip Cocoon and Rappel's crowd-control/escape usage entirely, since the fight has a stationary dummy and CC/mobility do not change damage dealt or taken.
